traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Mind meets imagination. Strong imagination and intuitive, associative thinking. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Inspired ideation and a feel for the unspoken. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize thinking and imagination into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what thinking and imagination have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Creative ideation; verify the details before acting on them.
shadow: The ease lets scattered overthinking and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.summary: A feeling you have struggled to explain may finally find language that another person can understand.
readerCopy.body: A feeling you have struggled to explain may finally find language that another person can understand. When Mercury sextiles Neptune, thought and intuition cooperate, making creative writing, emotional conversations, symbolism, music, and subtle observations easier to translate into something shareable. You do not have to strip all the feeling out of the message to make it clear. Anchor the abstract feeling to a concrete example so the other person has something real to grasp. Being deeply understood usually requires surgical precision in your language, not an endless explanation.
